title: Code for Breakdown of El Nino-enhanced marine heatwave predictability in 2023-2024
description: Calculation, diagnostic and plotting code for Figures 1-4 and supporting analyses in the manuscript Breakdown of El Nino-enhanced marine heatwave predictability in 2023-2024. The release includes lightweight derived products, provenance records and final figures; large third-party forecast and reanalysis archives are documented but not redistributed.
